title: Supreme Court rules Trump cannot fire Fed Governor Lisa Cook for now
title_zh: 最高法院裁定特朗普暂时不能解雇美联储理事丽莎·库克
text: The ruling by the Supreme Court means that Lisa Cook will remain as a Federal Reserve governor as her lawsuit challenging Trump's effort to fire her proceeds.
zh: 最高法院的裁决意味着丽莎·库克将继续担任美联储理事，她的诉讼质疑特朗普解雇她的收益的努力。

title: Trump says U.S. and Iran to hold fresh talks in Qatar on Tuesday following weekend clashes
title_zh: 特朗普称美国和伊朗在周末冲突后将于周二在卡塔尔举行新的会谈
text: The U.S. and Iran are poised to hold fresh talks on Tuesday in Qatar's capital, President Donald Trump said via social media on Monday.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周一通过社交媒体表示，美国和伊朗准备周二在卡塔尔首都举行新的会谈。

title: Oil prices near pre-war levels — but persistent supply risks could spark a rebound, analysts warn
title_zh: 分析师警告称，油价接近战前水平，但持续的供应风险可能引发反弹
text: Commodity strategists warn that Iranian leverage in the Strait of Hormuz will continue to weigh on oil markets and shipping costs.
zh: 大宗商品策略师警告称，伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡的影响力将继续打压石油市场和运输成本。

title: The Club's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Monday
title_zh: 俱乐部周一股市最值得关注的十大事件
text: Honeywell Aerospace starts trading, and a few more M&A deals.
zh: 霍尼韦尔航空航天公司开始交易，并进行了更多并购交易。

title: Fed’s Lisa Cook can stay at central bank while challenging Trump’s attempt to fire her, Supreme Court rules
title_zh: 最高法院裁定，美联储丽莎库克可以留在央行，同时挑战特朗普解雇她的企图
text: The Supreme Court refused to allow President Donald Trump to fire Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook, in a move that strengthens the independence of the world’s most powerful central bank.
zh: 最高法院拒绝允许唐纳德·特朗普总统解雇美联储理事丽莎·库克，此举加强了世界上最强大央行的独立性。

title: Rocket Lab to take on SpaceX’s Starlink with $8 billion acquisition
title_zh: Rocket Lab 将斥资 80 亿美元收购 SpaceX 的 Starlink
text: Rocket Lab said it is buying Iridium as a “shortcut” to expanding its growing capabilities.
zh: Rocket Lab 表示，收购 Iridium 作为扩大其不断增长的能力的“捷径”。

title: I’m 53 and want to retire in 12 years. Is 5% enough to put in my 401(k)?
title_zh: 我今年 53 岁，想在 12 年后退休。 5% 足够存入我的 401(k) 吗？
text: If you want to have enough for retirement, you need to push your savings limits today.
zh: 如果您想拥有足够的退休金，您今天就需要提高储蓄限额。

title: ‘I claimed Social Security at 62’: At 76, I’m working at Walmart. Why do I still owe payroll taxes?
title_zh: “我在 62 岁时领取了社会保障”：76 岁的我在沃尔玛工作。为什么我仍然欠工资税？
text: “It seems like half of the workforce at our local Walmart is over 65.”
zh: “我们当地的沃尔玛似乎有一半员工年龄超过 65 岁。”

title: Volkswagen’s stock nears a 15-year low on reports of massive planned layoffs
title_zh: 大规模裁员消息传出，大众汽车股价跌至 15 年来最低点
text: Shares in the German carmaker slumped following reports of a plan to cut up to 100,000 jobs.
zh: 在有报道称该公司计划裁员 10 万人后，这家德国汽车制造商的股价暴跌。

title: ‘I don’t think I’ll make it to 80’: I’m 70 and single. Do I take out a reverse mortgage or a home-equity agreement?
title_zh: “我不认为我能活到 80 岁”：我已经 70 岁了，还是单身。我是否需要申请反向抵押贷款或房屋净值协议？
text: “I’m torn between these two options.”
zh: “我在这两个选择之间左右为难。”

title: European stocks are poised to outdo their American peers. These catalysts explain why.
title_zh: 欧洲股市有望超越美国股市。这些催化剂解释了原因。
text: JPMorgan raises its year-end target for European stocks again. Panmure warns that high valuations imply negative returns for the U.S. in the next decade.
zh: 摩根大通再次上调欧洲股市年底目标。潘穆尔警告称，高估值意味着未来十年美国将出现负回报。

title: Laser weapons aren’t science fiction anymore — and they’re changing how defense stocks are valued
title_zh: 激光武器不再是科幻小说——它们正在改变国防股票的估值方式
text: Why Palantir and Elbit are top plays in the booming counterdrone market.
zh: 为什么 Palantir 和 Elbit 是蓬勃发展的反无人机市场中的佼佼者。

title: If you're surprised by how well the stock market is doing, so is Jamie Dimon - Fortune
title_zh: 如果你对股市的表现感到惊讶，那么杰米·戴蒙 (Jamie Dimon) 也会如此 - 《财富》
text: If you're surprised by how well the stock market is doing, so is Jamie Dimon Fortune
zh: 如果您对股市的表现感到惊讶，那么杰米·戴蒙 (Jamie Dimon) 也会感到惊讶 - 财富中文网

title: Is China’s High-Quality Investment Output Economically Viable? - Carnegie Endowment for International Peace
title_zh: 中国的高质量投资产出在经济上是否可行？ - 卡内基国际和平基金会
text: Is China’s High-Quality Investment Output Economically Viable? Carnegie Endowment for International Peace
zh: 中国的高质量投资产出在经济上是否可行？卡内基国际和平基金会

title: China tightens market oversight to create 'slow bull' momentum - Reuters
title_zh: 中国收紧市场监管创造“慢牛”势头 - 路透中文网
text: China tightens market oversight to create 'slow bull' momentum Reuters
zh: 中国收紧市场监管创造“慢牛”势头 路透

title: Comcast soars 23% after announcing it will spin off media and tech wings into separate public companies
title_zh: 康卡斯特宣布将把媒体和科技部门分拆为独立的上市公司后股价飙升 23%
text: Comcast said it will separate into two publicly traded companies through a tax-free spinoff of NBCUniversal and Sky
zh: 康卡斯特表示，将通过免税分拆 NBCUniversal 和 Sky 分成两家上市公司

title: SpaceX's $25 billion bond sale drives huge demand - and a potential headache for investors
title_zh: SpaceX 250 亿美元的债券发行带动了巨大的需求，但也可能让投资者头疼
text: SpaceX’s $25 billion debt sale drew heavy demand, but analysts warn of capital spending, refinancing and investor concentration risks.
zh: SpaceX 250 亿美元的债务出售吸引了大量需求，但分析师警告称，存在资本支出、再融资和投资者集中风险。

title: Trump bought as much as $5 million in Axon stock before ICE sought $220 million Taser deal
title_zh: 在 ICE 寻求 2.2 亿美元泰瑟枪交易之前，特朗普购买了价值 500 万美元的 Axon 股票
text: Axon Enterprise has ramped up lobbying in Congress on federal law-enforcement technology as ICE pursues a potential $220 million Taser deal.
zh: 随着 ICE 寻求价值 2.2 亿美元的泰瑟枪交易，Axon Enterprise 加大了在国会有关联邦执法技术的游说力度。

title: Putin’s fuel shortage admission signals growing strain on Russia’s energy infrastructure
title_zh: 普京承认燃料短缺表明俄罗斯能源基础设施的压力日益加大
text: Putin's comments mark the first time he has detailed the extent to which Ukraine's deep-strike successes have hampered Russia's fuel production.
zh: 普京的言论标志着他首次详细说明乌克兰的深度打击成功在多大程度上阻碍了俄罗斯的燃料生产。

title: 'This bargain is eroding': Inside the youngest generations' view of the American Dream
title_zh: “这种讨价还价正在消失”：最年轻一代对美国梦的看法
text: Gen Z is at a tipping point, some economists say: the first U.S. generation in living memory where the majority may be unable to achieve the American Dream.
zh: 一些经济学家表示，Z 世代正处于一个转折点：他们是人们记忆中的第一代美国人，其中大多数人可能无法实现美国梦。

title: China's economy picks up in June on rebounding U.S. exports, analysts say
title_zh: 分析师称，美国出口反弹，中国经济六月回升
text: China's economy is showing signs of picking up after a sluggish few months — thanks in part to a rebound in shipments to the U.S.
zh: 中国经济在经历了几个月的低迷之后，正显示出复苏的迹象，部分原因是对美国的出口量出现反弹。

title: Before there were Trump Accounts, SEED OK gave some newborns $1,000 — how researchers say the grants affected kids
title_zh: 在特朗普账户出现之前，SEED OK 向一些新生儿提供了 1,000 美元——研究人员称这些赠款如何影响孩子
text: Some state-sponsored programs paved the way for Trump Accounts, the new tax-deferred investing accounts for children.
zh: 一些国家资助的项目为特朗普账户（新的儿童递延税投资账户）铺平了道路。

title: Silver and the semiconductor climax — a warning from Morgan Stanley’s Wilson
title_zh: 白银和半导体高潮——摩根士丹利威尔逊的警告
text: Investors should shift away from popular momentum trades, says strategist
zh: 策略师表示，投资者应该放弃流行的动量交易

title: People say I should wait until 70 to claim Social Security. When does delaying pay off?
title_zh: 人们说我应该等到 70 岁才能领取社会保障。拖延什么时候才能得到回报？
text: “Too many people believe that if they wait until 70 to begin collecting, they are automatically better off.”
zh: “太多人认为，如果等到 70 岁才开始收集，他们的生活自然会变得更好。”

title: Why Apple pivoting to China for memory may not solve big tech’s microchip crisis
title_zh: 为什么苹果将存储重心转向中国可能无法解决大型科技公司的微芯片危机
text: Apple reportedly is looking to ease its memory crunch with a Chinese company, but the dominance of the big three makers continues, says one tech investor.
zh: 据报道，苹果正在寻求与一家中国公司合作缓解内存短缺问题，但一位科技投资者表示，三大制造商的主导地位仍在继续。

title: Comcast to spin off NBCUniversal after 15 years of ownership
title_zh: 持有 NBCUniversal 15 年后，康卡斯特将分拆
text: Comcast on Monday said it would spin off NBCUniversal into a separate company, breaking off the media business it acquired 15 years ago
zh: 康卡斯特周一表示，将把 NBCUniversal 分拆为一家独立公司，结束其 15 年前收购的媒体业务

title: Magnificent Seven slump sent momentum stocks to their fourth worst performance in 22 years. Here’s what happens 70% of the time.
title_zh: 七大暴跌导致动量股出现 22 年来第四差表现。 70% 的情况下都会发生这种情况。
text: The S&P 500 underperformed its equally weighted counterpart by 350 basis points last week
zh: 上周标准普尔 500 指数的表现落后于同等权重的同行 350 个基点

title: The central bank of central banks warns AI frenzy could trigger stock-market slump and jeopardize economy
title_zh: 央行警告人工智能狂热可能引发股市暴跌并危及经济
text: Rich stock market valuations, investor complacency, circular financing, and the potential knock-on effects in credit markets are a clear warning in the BIS annual report
zh: 国际清算银行年度报告明确警告股市估值过高、投资者自满、循环融资以及信贷市场潜在的连锁反应

title: Why ‘permabear’ Jeremy Grantham is steering his own cash into high-flying tech companies
title_zh: 为什么“永久熊”杰里米·格兰瑟姆将自己的资金投入到高速发展的科技公司
text: A viral social-media post this weekend took Jeremy Grantham bashing a step further by looking at the investing legend’s own investments.
zh: 本周末，一篇在社交媒体上疯传的帖子让杰里米·格兰瑟姆 (Jeremy Grantham) 进一步抨击了这位投资传奇人物自己的投资。

title: After her return to the spotlight, ‘Every Year After’ star Elisha Cuthbert relists her Hollywood Hills home for $2.1 million
title_zh: 重返聚光灯下后，《每一年之后》明星伊丽莎·库斯伯特 (Elisha Cuthbert) 以 210 万美元的价格重新挂牌出售她在好莱坞山的住宅
text: Actress Elisha Cuthbert is again trying to sell her luxurious L.A. pad for nearly $2.1 million— weeks after making a sudden return to acting following a long hiatus.
zh: 女演员伊丽莎·库斯伯特 (Elisha Cuthbert) 在长期中断演艺生涯后突然重返演艺圈几周后，再次试图以近 210 万美元的价格出售她在洛杉矶的豪华住所。

title: The AI boom is colliding with a new threat: severe weather
title_zh: 人工智能的繁荣正与新的威胁相冲突：恶劣天气
text: Heatwaves and severe weather are raising risks for AI data centers, from grid strain to higher insurance and repair costs.
zh: 热浪和恶劣天气正在增加人工智能数据中心的风险，从电网压力到更高的保险和维修成本。

title: China widens Japan export curbs, targeting drone makers, nuclear firms and defense institutes
title_zh: 中国扩大对日本的出口限制，针对无人机制造商、核公司和国防机构
text: China blacklisted four of Japan's government defense research institutes and placed dozens more Japanese firms under tightened export restrictions Monday.
zh: 周一，中国将四家日本政府防务研究机构列入黑名单，并对数十家日本公司实施更严格的出口限制。

title: Baidu shares jump 7% as AI chip arm Kunlunxin said to target $50 billion Hong Kong IPO
title_zh: 人工智能芯片公司昆仑欣计划在香港IPO，融资规模达500亿美元 百度股价大涨7%
text: Baidu's Hong Kong-listed shares rose over 6% amid reports that its AI chip unit Kunlunxin is targeting a $50 billion initial public offering in the city.
zh: 百度在香港上市的股价上涨超过 6%，有报道称其人工智能芯片子公司昆仑欣计划在香港进行 500 亿美元的首次公开募股。

title: Samsung, SK Hynix shares fall as investors brace for reported $1.3 trillion spending plans
title_zh: 三星和 SK 海力士股价下跌，因投资者准备迎接 1.3 万亿美元的支出计划
text: Shares of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix plunged after reports surfaced that the pair are expected to unveil investment plans worth hundreds of billions of dollars.
zh: 有报道称三星电子和 SK 海力士预计将公布价值数千亿美元的投资计划，导致三星电子和 SK 海力士股价暴跌。

title: The memory shortage shaking Apple and Microsoft is 'existential crisis' for smaller players
title_zh: 震动苹果和微软的内存短缺对小型企业来说是“生存危机”
text: While Apple and Microsoft raise prices on key devices to help cover the soaring costs of memory, smaller consumer electronics companies are in dire straits.
zh: 尽管苹果和微软提高了关键设备的价格，以帮助弥补不断飙升的内存成本，但规模较小的消费电子公司却陷入了困境。

title: ‘Heated Rivalry’ fuels a boom in gay romance stories, with women leading the fandom
title_zh: “激烈的竞争”推动了同性恋浪漫故事的繁荣，女性引领了粉丝群体
text: ‘Heated Rivalry’ has helped gay romance stories gain mainstream attention, with women driving much of the fandom.
zh: “激烈的竞争”帮助同性恋浪漫故事获得了主流关注，其中女性主导了大部分粉丝群体。

title: SpaceX to join the Nasdaq-100 in a fast-tracked process that will drive huge ETF buying demand
title_zh: SpaceX 将快速加入纳斯达克 100 指数，这将推动巨大的 ETF 购买需求
text: Adding SpaceX this quickly would make the Elon Musk company one of the first beneficiaries of Nasdaq's recently adopted fast-track inclusion framework.
zh: 如此迅速地加入 SpaceX 将使埃隆·马斯克公司成为纳斯达克最近采用的快速纳入框架的首批受益者之一。

title: Berkshire CEO Greg Abel sworn in as U.S. citizen at baseball game
title_zh: 伯克希尔首席执行官格雷格·阿贝尔在棒球比赛中宣誓就任美国公民
text: Abel, a longtime Iowa resident who was born in the Canadian city of Edmonton in 1962, was among the roughly two dozen people from 16 countries who participated in an annual naturalization ceremony hosted by the Iowa Cubs Thursday night in Des Moines.
zh: 阿贝尔是爱荷华州的长期居民，1962 年出生于加拿大埃德蒙顿，来自 16 个国家的大约两打人参加了周四晚上由爱荷华小熊队在得梅因举办的年度入籍仪式。

title: How GE Vernova builds the massive gas turbines powering the AI data center boom
title_zh: GE Vernova 如何建造大型燃气轮机为人工智能数据中心的繁荣提供动力
text: GE Vernova turbines are powering Elon Musk's xAI Colossus 1 data center and Microsoft just bought seven to power its data center in Texas.
zh: GE Vernova 涡轮机正在为埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 xAI Colossus 1 数据中心供电，而微软刚刚购买了 7 台涡轮机为其位于德克萨斯州的数据中心供电。

title: How Kohl's lost its way — and is trying to become relevant again
title_zh: Kohl's 如何迷失方向并试图再次变得重要
text: Kohl's went from a household name to a plunging stock as it lost relevancy and its core customer. Now, the company is trying to turn itself around.
zh: 由于失去了相关性和核心客户，科尔从一个家喻户晓的名字变成了一只暴跌的股票。现在，该公司正在努力扭转局面。

title: Trading in these two ETFs suggests inflation fears are overblown
title_zh: 这两只 ETF 的交易表明通胀担忧被夸大了
text: It could have been a big week for bond bears, if it weren't for crude oil.
zh: 如果没有原油，这对债券空头来说可能是重要的一周。

title: China’s Market Revival Hinges on Gloomy Economy Turning Corner - Bloomberg.com
title_zh: 中国市场复苏取决于低迷经济的拐点 - Bloomberg.com
text: China’s Market Revival Hinges on Gloomy Economy Turning Corner Bloomberg.com
zh: 中国市场复苏取决于低迷经济的拐点 Bloomberg.com

title: China's wary consumers saved tons of cash. Now, they're pouring it into stocks. - markets.businessinsider.com
title_zh: 中国谨慎的消费者节省了大量现金。现在，他们正将其投入股市。 - market.businessinsider.com
text: China's wary consumers saved tons of cash. Now, they're pouring it into stocks. markets.businessinsider.com
zh: 中国谨慎的消费者节省了大量现金。现在，他们正将其投入股市。市场.businessinsider.com

title: Treasury Secretary Bessent says a stock market decline won't deter the U.S. from taking strong action against China - CNBC
title_zh: 美国财长贝森特表示股市下跌不会阻止美国对中国采取强硬行动 - CNBC
text: Treasury Secretary Bessent says a stock market decline won't deter the U.S. from taking strong action against China CNBC
zh: 美国财政部长贝森特表示，股市下跌不会阻止美国对中国采取强硬行动

title: China’s surging A-share market: Recovery or bubble in disguise? - ThinkChina
title_zh: 中国A股市场飙升：复苏还是变相泡沫？ - 思考中国
text: China’s surging A-share market: Recovery or bubble in disguise? ThinkChina
zh: 中国A股市场飙升：复苏还是变相泡沫？思考中国

title: Oil jumps back above $70 as fresh U.S.-Iran clashes reignite Middle East supply fears
title_zh: 美伊新冲突重燃中东供应担忧 油价回升至 70 美元上方
text: Oil edged higher on Monday after renewed military strikes between the U.S. and Iran reignited concerns over crude supplies from the Middle East.
zh: 美国和伊朗之间再次发动军事打击，重新引发对中东原油供应的担忧，周一油价小幅走高。

title: If you think China needs to dethrone U.S. dollar, you don't understand how it is waging global currency war
title_zh: 如果你认为中国需要推翻美元，那你就不明白它是如何发动全球货币战争的
text: It's misguided to focus on China's renminbi replacing the U.S. dollar. Beijing is already successfully reducing dependence on a dollar-centric global system.
zh: 关注人民币取代美元是错误的。北京已经成功减少了对以美元为中心的全球体系的依赖。

title: IRAs hold trillions more than 401(k) plans — yet people hardly save in them
title_zh: IRA 持有的资金比 401(k) 计划多出数万亿美元——但人们却很少在其中存钱
text: Investors are increasingly rolling money from 401(k) plans to IRAs. Some observers fear they're exposed to poor investment advice.
zh: 投资者越来越多地将资金从 401(k) 计划转入 IRA。一些观察家担心他们会收到糟糕的投资建议。

title: Some renters say homeownership isn't part of their American Dream: Renting is 'really freeing for me'
title_zh: 一些租房者表示，拥有住房并不是他们美国梦的一部分：租房“对我来说真的是一种自由”
text: Some no longer see renting as a temporary stop on the path to homeownership but rather a long-term lifestyle choice, reflecting a shift in the American Dream.
zh: 一些人不再将租房视为买房道路上的暂时停止，而是一种长期的生活方式选择，反映了美国梦的转变。

title: America can't get enough of protein. The dairy industry can't keep up
title_zh: 美国无法获得足够的蛋白质。乳制品行业跟不上
text: Demand for whey protein is off the charts as American diet trends change and GLP-1s boom, and the dairy industry is struggling to produce enough.

title: I had gallbladder surgery. After I got home, the hospital asked me for a financial donation. Is this ethical?

text: “The letter asked whether I had a favorite caregiver and if I would like to make a contribution in their honor.”
zh: “这封信询问我是否有最喜欢的看护者，以及我是否愿意为他们的荣誉做出贡献。”

zh: 有了数字健康记录，临床医生和人工智能驱动的诊断工具将能够查看您的完整健康史，然后做出更好的决策。
